title: Ai development orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai development orchestrator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users

Start: Immediate

The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.

The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.

What You Do

Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.

Must-Haves

Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.

Strong Signals

Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy.

Red Flags

AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.

Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.

How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.

What We Offer

A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.

To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Automatizar a avaliação de qualidade: Implementar pipelines de \"LLM-as-a-Judge\" para auditar a qualidade das respostas da IA em escala. Construir a personalização da IA: Desenvolver e implementar sistemas de memória conversacional de longo prazo (usando frameworks como Lang Chain) para que o sistema possa se lembrar do contexto e do históricos de interações. Arquitetar sistemas de múltiplos agentes: Projetar e construir uma arquitetura de agentes especialistas, com um router inteligente que direciona as requisições para o agentes mais adequados. Trabalhar com LLMs: Utilizar e otimizar os mais recentes modelos de linguagem (GPT, Claude, etc.), aplicando técnicas de prompt engineering para maximizar a qualidade das respostas. Contribuir para a vetorização do conhecimento: Apoiar a iniciativa estratégica de \"IA Onipresente\", ajudando a estruturar e vetorizar todo o acervo acadêmico do Gran para torná-lo acessível à IA. Definir contratos de dados: Colaborar com o Desenvolvedores de software para definir as APIs e os contratos de dados necessários para servir os modelos de IA com eficiência e baixa latência.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que buscamos:

Experiência em Engenharia de IA/ML, com foco em IA Generativa e LLMs. Conhecimento e experiência prática na construção e otimização de sistemas RAG. Domínio de Python e de frameworks de IA como Lang Chain, Llama Index e/ou Hugging Face. Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais (ex: Open Search, Milvus, Weaviate) e de Grafos (ex. Neo4j, Falkordb) Compreensão de prompt engineering, técnicas de avaliação de LLMs e estratégias de redução de alucinação. Experiência com a utilização de serviços de cloud (preferencialmente AWS) para deploy e gerenciamento de soluções de IA.

Diferenciais:

Experiência na construção de sistemas de múltiplos agentes (multi-agent systems). Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade para LLMs (ex: Lang Fuse). Experiência com \"LLM-as-a-Judge\" para avaliação automatizada. Vivência em projetos que envolvem a ingestão e o processamento de grandes volumes de dados para alimentar sistemas de IA.

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico Sul América com cobertura nacional, custeado em 100% pela empresa. Wellhub (Gympass) ou reembolso de academia. Aplicativo para agendamento de massagem. Aplicativos Starbem, Avus e Auster: saúde, bem-estar e suporte completo, incluindo assistência psicológica, financeira e jurídica.

Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação pagos no cartão i Food.

Auxílio Home Office pago no cartão i Food. PLR de acordo com as regras vigentes. Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas. Gran Pix - Programa de reconhecimento de projetos com premiações. Auxílio-Creche.

title: Assistant production manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistant production manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About

At , we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. Our work helps individuals and teams present themselves with consistency and confidence across digital platforms.

We're looking for an Assistant Production Manager, reporting to the Production Manager, who will co-lead our photo editing and quality control teams, guide strategy and drive operational excellence.

About the Role

This role combines production oversight with a deep appreciation for the artistry of headshot retouching. You'll manage the daily operations of our editing team, ensuring that each image reflects the clarity, subtlety, and professionalism our brand is known for.

We're seeking someone who brings both technical expertise and a discerning creative eye—someone who can guide a team to produce beautiful, natural edits that elevate the subject rather than over-process them.

Key Responsibilities

Production & Quality Control

Co-develop strategic initiatives to strengthen and improve production operations Ensure timely reporting and clear communication across production workflows Oversee daily editing operations to support consistent, high-quality delivery of headshots Maintain quality standards across visual consistency, lighting, natural retouching, and overall image polish Identify recurring issues, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous improvement across the production team Step in as needed to assist with editing, troubleshooting, or complex production requests

Team Leadership & Coaching

Supervise and mentor a team of photo editors Hire, train, and onboard new editors to uphold brand standards Foster a collaborative, high-accountability culture with clear communication

Workflow Management & Operational Oversight

Monitor task queues and deadlines to ensure smooth project flow Optimize systems and tools to eliminate inefficiencies or bottlenecks Lead team meetings, track KPIs, and document standard operating procedures

Client & Project Coordination

Collaborate across internal teams to meet client-specific requirements Maintain a client-centered approach while balancing quality and turnaround Support the development of background templates, sample images, and visual assets as needed

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

6+ years of photo retouching experience, especially in headshots or portraits 3+ years managing creative or production teams Experience with tools like Dropbox, Asana, and Slack Strong organizational and communication skills

Mindset & Strengths

Excellent attention to detail and visual aesthetics A \"no-ego\" team player: You leave your ego at the door, take extreme ownership of your work, and build deep trust through transparent communication. Reliable, deadline-driven, and calm under pressure Creative problem-solver with a passion for helping people look their best Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a collaborative team environment

Why Join Us?

Flexible, remote work Work with a high-performing creative team Opportunity to shape the quality and scale of a fast-growing brand

Compensation: $16-18/hour (full-time contract) depending on experience

Schedule: Monday to Friday | Flexible hours (ET hours)

IMPORTANT:

Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Support analyst l2 - bilingual
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Support analyst l2 - bilingual em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description

Please submit resumes in English. Strong English speaking and writing communication skills are required.

As a Support Analyst L2, you will troubleshoot operational issues with the Warehouse Management System (WMS), manage configurations, support cloud solutions, monitor SQL performance, and maintain documentation. You bring expertise with Oracle Web Logic Server, Oracle Databases, cloud services, Linux systems, supply chain technologies, and various hardware/software tools used in warehouse and distribution operations.

What a day in the life looks like:

Troubleshoot business and operational issues associated with the Warehouse Management System (WMS) and ancillary software. Quantify issues and provide supporting data if issues are escalated to the ERP Vendor. Manage the WMS environments and migration of configurations between environments. Support the operation and continuous improvement of the monitoring of our cloud solutions. SQL performance monitoring, index, and query tuning. Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, troubleshooting steps, and support processes for future reference and knowledgebase articles.

What you bring to the team:

BS/BA in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent; 5+ years of technical customer support experience. 3+ years of experience with SQL/Oracle. Advantage: Experience in software development. Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services (AWS, Azure, OCI, Google Cloud). Advantage: Experience with supply chain, distribution, and interface technologies.

title: Hnw client manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hnw client manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote | Athens HQ support Independent Contractor Uncapped commission with strong earning potential for top performers

Who We Are

Ambitious people deserve options regardless of where they were born.

Pass Beyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families — gaining Schengen access, international asset diversification, and long-term optionality.

Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. Pass Beyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.

We're looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from your network.

The Role

This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals — and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.

You will:

Introduce Pass Beyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks — so they can make an informed decision Guide clients from first conversation through to permit in hand Build trust through genuine conversation — not scripts or pressure tactics Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters

We're not looking for cold-callers. We're looking for trusted advisors.

Who Our Clients Are

Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest Successful individuals who have built or grown significant wealth Discerning clients who value due diligence and take time to make important decisions Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families They value relationships over transactions and won't be rushed or pressured

Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their care in decision-making, and guides with patience and honesty.

What We're Looking For

Essential:

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Ai development orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai development orchestrator em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users

Start: Immediate

The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.

The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.

What You Do

Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.

Must-Haves

Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.

Strong Signals

Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy.

Red Flags

AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.

Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.

How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.

What We Offer

title: Business intelligence analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business intelligence analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.

About the Role

We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.

Responsibilities

Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively

Requirements

Strong SQL skills Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics Comfortable working in a remote environment Able to pass a background check

Preferred

Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data Experience with BI and visualization tools Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment Experience with AWS-based data environments Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation Experience with Click House or similar analytical databases Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts

How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

title: Technical project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical project manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.

About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, Git Hub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.

Required Skills

ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero

Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.

We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.

The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.

About the Role

This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS.

You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.

What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

Full Stack Engineering

Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.

AWS native Architecture

Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized.

Systems Integration

Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

AI Forward Development

Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform.

Collaboration & Impact

Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.

What We Are Looking For

8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.

Why Freight Hero

Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

title: Assistant production manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistant production manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About

At , we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. Our work helps individuals and teams present themselves with consistency and confidence across digital platforms.

We're looking for an Assistant Production Manager, reporting to the Production Manager, who will co-lead our photo editing and quality control teams, guide strategy and drive operational excellence.

About the Role

This role combines production oversight with a deep appreciation for the artistry of headshot retouching. You'll manage the daily operations of our editing team, ensuring that each image reflects the clarity, subtlety, and professionalism our brand is known for.

We're seeking someone who brings both technical expertise and a discerning creative eye—someone who can guide a team to produce beautiful, natural edits that elevate the subject rather than over-process them.

Key Responsibilities

Production & Quality Control

Co-develop strategic initiatives to strengthen and improve production operations Ensure timely reporting and clear communication across production workflows Oversee daily editing operations to support consistent, high-quality delivery of headshots Maintain quality standards across visual consistency, lighting, natural retouching, and overall image polish Identify recurring issues, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous improvement across the production team Step in as needed to assist with editing, troubleshooting, or complex production requests

Team Leadership & Coaching

Supervise and mentor a team of photo editors Hire, train, and onboard new editors to uphold brand standards Foster a collaborative, high-accountability culture with clear communication

Workflow Management & Operational Oversight

Monitor task queues and deadlines to ensure smooth project flow Optimize systems and tools to eliminate inefficiencies or bottlenecks Lead team meetings, track KPIs, and document standard operating procedures

Client & Project Coordination

Collaborate across internal teams to meet client-specific requirements Maintain a client-centered approach while balancing quality and turnaround Support the development of background templates, sample images, and visual assets as needed

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

6+ years of photo retouching experience, especially in headshots or portraits 3+ years managing creative or production teams Experience with tools like Dropbox, Asana, and Slack Strong organizational and communication skills

Mindset & Strengths

Excellent attention to detail and visual aesthetics A \"no-ego\" team player: You leave your ego at the door, take extreme ownership of your work, and build deep trust through transparent communication. Reliable, deadline-driven, and calm under pressure Creative problem-solver with a passion for helping people look their best Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a collaborative team environment

Why Join Us?

Flexible, remote work Work with a high-performing creative team Opportunity to shape the quality and scale of a fast-growing brand

Compensation: $16-18/hour (full-time contract) depending on experience

Schedule: Monday to Friday | Flexible hours (ET hours)

IMPORTANT:

Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Ingeniero de nube
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ingeniero de nube em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Top Skills' Details

1.) 5 years of experience with software engineering and in designing and building cloud native integrations.

2.) 4 years of AWS development experience (specifically with serverless and event driven architectures). 75% of the role will be focused on Development (mostly new development).

3.) 2+ years of Architecture/Design experience. This consultant must understand high level AWS best practices for code development, security standards, how to best scale & conducting code reviews for the team. This Sr Consultant will be working directly with the business to gather requirements and work with the team to ensure best development practices for delivery.

3.) 5+ years with full stack engineering background (Java Script / Type Script preferred).

4.) Hands on experience integrating with Net Suite (Suite Talk, Suite Script) and Salesforce APIs.

Job Description:

Our Client is the nation's leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‐integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience, strong full‐stack engineering skills, and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‐native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically Net Suite, Salesforce, and other enterprise applications.

You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‐on coding and deployment automation.

title: Brazil packaging salesperson, remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Brazil packaging salesperson, remote em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.

Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets

Qualifications

- Proven track record of successful B2 B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Hnw client manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hnw client manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote | Athens HQ support Independent Contractor Uncapped commission with strong earning potential for top performers

Who We Are

Ambitious people deserve options regardless of where they were born.

Pass Beyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families — gaining Schengen access, international asset diversification, and long-term optionality.

Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. Pass Beyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.

We're looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from your network.

The Role

This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals — and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.

You will:

Introduce Pass Beyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks — so they can make an informed decision Guide clients from first conversation through to permit in hand Build trust through genuine conversation — not scripts or pressure tactics Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters

We're not looking for cold-callers. We're looking for trusted advisors.

Who Our Clients Are

Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest Successful individuals who have built or grown significant wealth Discerning clients who value due diligence and take time to make important decisions Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families They value relationships over transactions and won't be rushed or pressured

Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their care in decision-making, and guides with patience and honesty.

What We're Looking For

Essential:

Existing relationships with high-net-worth individuals Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you'd serve Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal) Comfortable with performance-based compensation Integrity - you'd rather lose a deal than mislead someone

Highly Desirable:

Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services

Backgrounds that often do well:

Business owners and entrepreneurs Private bankers and wealth managers Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets Community leaders and well-connected professionals

What You Get

Full training and certification on our programmes — no cost to you Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens) Psychological messaging framework and conversation guides designed for high-stakes, trust-based advisory — not generic sales scripts CRM system for pipeline management Branded marketing materials and property documents ready to share with clients Direct support from our Athens headquarters — legal coordination, transaction management, and immigration filing handled for you As we grow together, you'll receive warm leads from our marketing campaigns alongside your own network

Our Values

Freedom — The right to become who you are capable of becoming, unconstrained by the circumstances of your birth.

Integrity — Not a character trait, but an infrastructure. We engineer trustworthiness into every process.

Partnership — We build relationships, not transactions. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.

description:

title: Médico endocrinologista (rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico endocrinologista (rqe) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

Nosso time de profissionais desempenha um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. title: Senior software engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior software engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base.

Mission

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line. Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage. Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications. Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability. Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange. Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience. Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance.

Whom Are We looking For

We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You'll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value.

Key Qualifications

Node.js, Type Script & React Expertise: Extensive experience with Node JS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices. Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies. TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code. Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand. Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health. Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release. Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus. Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team. Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity.

Bonus Qualifications

Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads. AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions. Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus. Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

description:

Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup Availability to work during overlapping U. S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required) Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

Competitive compensation commensurate with experience Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

Veterinary Radiologist - Remote

Signal PET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.

About the Company

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp's diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company's mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.

About the Role

The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations. Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control. Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions. Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance.

Vendor & MSP Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services. Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs. Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Remove blockers, escalate critical issues, and maintain reliable delivery pipelines. Ensure consistent communication between internal teams and external ISPs. Coordinate with Global Logistics for shipping the orders to ensure SLAs are met.

Delivery Governance & Compliance

Ensure accurate documentation including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOPs, RACI, and risk registers. Maintain end-to-end asset traceability using internal tooling (Salesforce).

Reporting & Metrics

Provide weekly and monthly executive reports on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigations. Track, productivity, throughput, and cycle-time metrics.

Qualifications

8–12+ years of project/program management in large-scale datacenter or cloud infrastructure environments. Experience working with or within hyperscalers. Strong background managing MSP vendors delivering hardware, network, logistics, and field operations. Deep understanding of data-center operational workflows, racks/cabling, networking basics, migrations, decom, and capacity builds. Proficiency with PM tools. Excellent communication, executive reporting, and stakeholder negotiation skills. Experience with Lean, Agile, or scaled delivery frameworks.

Preferred Skills

PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent certifications. Experience with global, multi-region deployments across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Ability to analyze operational metrics, and implement continuous improvement.
