Confira esta oportunidade para Senior software engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (L3) - Healthcare Tech Nonprofit

Want your code to actually matter?

We're hiring on behalf of a mission-driven healthcare technology nonprofit whose platform has reached tens of millions of patients in low-income communities across the US. They're growing the team that builds the Saa S product hundreds of safety-net clinics rely on every day to manage patients and run patient engagement programs.

This is a senior IC role with shared team-lead responsibilities - owning complex full-stack features end-to-end, mentoring mid-level engineers, and shaping architecture across a Rails monolith and React SPA.

The Stack Ruby on Rails · React · Type Script · Postgre SQL · Google Cloud · Sidekiq

What You'll Own

Driving the technical direction of key Applications platform features Shipping full-stack work end-to-end: API → data model → UI Mentoring L2 engineers and leading technical design discussions Contributing to architectural decisions across the monolith and SPA Sharing on-call duties and helping evolve engineering standards

What We're Looking For

8+ years full-stack experience, with deep Rails + modern React fluency A track record of owning complex features from design through production Advanced SQL and a genuinely analytical, evidence-led mindset Proven ability to mentor and influence technical direction Excellent async communication — this is a fully distributed team Real excitement about mission-driven work

Bonus Points

Healthcare tech, social services, or other practitioner-facing domains Multi-tenant data models, RBAC, accessibility-aware UI Experience scaling a Rails monolith with a React SPA frontend

Interested? Apply here or message me directly - happy to walk you through the role, the team, and the mission before you commit to a full process.

title: Designer de apresentações (pleno/sênior) - banco de talentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Designer de apresentações (pleno/sênior) - banco de talentos em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.

Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile); Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes; Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão; Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos; Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações; Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.

Requerimentos & Skills:

Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas; Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo Power Point, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos. Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e In Design) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais; Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente; Inglês avançado/fluente.

Está preparado(a) para cultivar novas experiências em um time que joga junto e valoriza o melhor de cada um(a)?

#VEMSERSTUDIORX

--

Consideramos todas as aplicações para nossas vagas sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, cultura, origem, religião, deficiência, idade etc. Acreditamos na construção de um mundo mais diverso, com mais representatividade e livre de preconceitos. Aqui você encontra um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e inclusivo que promove o desenvolvimento por meio das conexões humanas!

title: Latam decom project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Latam decom project manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp's diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company's mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.

About the Role

The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations. Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control. Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions. Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance.

Vendor & MSP Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services. Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs. Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Remove blockers, escalate critical issues, and maintain reliable delivery pipelines. Ensure consistent communication between internal teams and external ISPs. Coordinate with Global Logistics for shipping the orders to ensure SLAs are met.

Delivery Governance & Compliance

Ensure accurate documentation including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOPs, RACI, and risk registers. Maintain end-to-end asset traceability using internal tooling (Salesforce).

Reporting & Metrics

Provide weekly and monthly executive reports on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigations. Track, productivity, throughput, and cycle-time metrics.

Qualifications

8–12+ years of project/program management in large-scale datacenter or cloud infrastructure environments. Experience working with or within hyperscalers. Strong background managing MSP vendors delivering hardware, network, logistics, and field operations. Deep understanding of data-center operational workflows, racks/cabling, networking basics, migrations, decom, and capacity builds. Proficiency with PM tools. Excellent communication, executive reporting, and stakeholder negotiation skills. Experience with Lean, Agile, or scaled delivery frameworks.

Preferred Skills

PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent certifications. Experience with global, multi-region deployments across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Ability to analyze operational metrics, and implement continuous improvement.

Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at.

As such, our organization may use automated tools including artificial intelligence, to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications or identifying relevant experience and education. These tools assist our teams, and all final hiring decisions are made following human review. If you have questions or concerns about our process, please contact us at.

title: Médico endocrinologista (rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico endocrinologista (rqe) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Vexos platform manager (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vexos platform manager (remote) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil

The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.

We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

About The Render Pros / VEXOS

We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3 D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The Role

The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.

You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What You'll Be Responsible For

• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date

• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track

• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed

• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What We're Looking For

Experience

• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role

• Experience working with Saa S platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus

• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement

Skills

• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily

• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly

• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift

Mindset

• You follow through. Every time.

• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

title: Latam decom project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Latam decom project manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp's diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company's mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.

About the Role

The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations. Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control. Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions. Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance.

Vendor & MSP Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services. Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs. Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Remove blockers, escalate critical issues, and maintain reliable delivery pipelines. Ensure consistent communication between internal teams and external ISPs. Coordinate with Global Logistics for shipping the orders to ensure SLAs are met.

Delivery Governance & Compliance

Ensure accurate documentation including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOPs, RACI, and risk registers. Maintain end-to-end asset traceability using internal tooling (Salesforce).

Reporting & Metrics

Provide weekly and monthly executive reports on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigations. Track, productivity, throughput, and cycle-time metrics.

Qualifications

8–12+ years of project/program management in large-scale datacenter or cloud infrastructure environments. Experience working with or within hyperscalers. Strong background managing MSP vendors delivering hardware, network, logistics, and field operations. Deep understanding of data-center operational workflows, racks/cabling, networking basics, migrations, decom, and capacity builds. Proficiency with PM tools. Excellent communication, executive reporting, and stakeholder negotiation skills. Experience with Lean, Agile, or scaled delivery frameworks.

Preferred Skills

PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent certifications. Experience with global, multi-region deployments across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Ability to analyze operational metrics, and implement continuous improvement.

description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO CARDIOLOGISTA (desejável RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Cardiologia. Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

Nosso time de profissionais desempenha um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em cardiologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios cardiológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em cardiologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças cardiológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM CARDIOLOGIA, ou Especialização, residência concluída, ou em andamento.

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista em cardiologia (RQE), emitido pelo Conselho Regional de Medicina do respectivo Estado ; ou matrícula em curso de residência, especialização, ou pós, em andamento; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em cardiologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúde cardiológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Cardiologia.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements

  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.

  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .

  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;

title: AI Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Software Engineer (Full-Stack) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre a posição


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Full-Stack Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos que combinam infraestrutura crítica com Inteligência Artificial, em um ambiente onde segurança, escala e performance não são negociáveis.

Você vai liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento, do desenho de interfaces à arquitetura de backend, com integração direta a soluções de IA. Se você tem visão de produto, autonomia técnica e pensa em sistemas antes de pensar em código, queremos conversar.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento full-stack: desde interfaces até backend, integrações com modelos de IA e monitoramento em produção;
  • Definir arquitetura e fluxos de usuário utilizando ferramentas e agentes de IA como apoio à geração, testes e evolução de código;
  • Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis para uso intensivo de LLMs, com foco em performance, disponibilidade e experiência do usuário
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD e MLOps para entrega contínua e segura de aplicações e modelos;
  • Garantir qualidade técnica por meio de revisões de código e aderência a boas práticas de engenharia e segurança da informação;
  • Ser referência técnica no time, contribuindo para a disseminação do desenvolvimento assistido por IA.


Competências técnicas


  • Sólida base em engenharia de software: algoritmos, design de sistemas e arquitetura full-stack independente de linguagem;
  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou Replit;
  • Domínio de ecossistemas de IA: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, LangChain ou Llama Index;
  • Experiência com APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Capacidade de implementar testes automatizados ao longo do ciclo de vida do software;
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.


Conhecimentos desejáveis


  • Experiência com gestão ágil de produtos, incluindo priorização de backlog e alinhamento técnico-negócio;
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em ética de IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e mitigação de vieses em modelos.


Sobre a UPX


Há mais de 20 anos, a UPX protege ambientes digitais que não podem falhar. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.


Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA.


Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. Se você gosta de pensar no todo, não só na sua parte, você pensa como nós.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Go Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Go Developer

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts
  • Advanced English skills.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;
  • Interest in GenAI and LLM technologies.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Product Owner
description:

Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Web3 & Al Investment Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.

This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.



What You’ll Be Doing



  • Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.
  • Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.
  • Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.
  • Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.


What We’re Looking For



  • 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.
  • Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.
  • Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.
  • Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.
  • Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.
  • Fluent English with strong written communication skills.
  • High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.


Why Join Web3DXB



  • Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.
  • Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.
  • High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.
  • Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.
  • Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.


If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Arquitetura de Segurança Cloud AWS - 132141
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquitetura de Segurança Cloud AWS - 132141 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Segurança/AWS).

Responsabilidades:

Arquiteto especializado em segurança para ambientes financeiros críticos, responsável por definir, validar e garantir controles de segurança fim a fim para cargas de trabalho relacionadas ao PIX na AWS, incluindo integração híbrida com ambientes on-premises, HSM e requisitos regulatórios. Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS.

  • Definir arquitetura de segurança alinhada ao AWS Well-Architected Framework (Pilar de Segurança);
  • Projetar estratégia de IAM (federação, RBAC, privilégio mínimo);
  • Definir estratégia de criptografia (em trânsito e em repouso);
  • Integrar soluções HSM (on-prem e cloud);
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos do BACEN e LGPD;
  • Definir padrões de segurança para containers (EKS/ROSA);
  • Implementar estratégia de segurança multi-conta e landing zone;
  • Conduzir modelagem de ameaças e avaliações de risco;
  • Apoiar POCs com validação de segurança e verificações de conformidade.

Requisitos :

  • AWS IAM, AWS KMS, AWS CloudHSM;
  • Criptografia (PKI, TLS, assinaturas digitais);
  • Segurança de APIs (OAuth2, OpenID Connect);
  • Segurança de containers e Kubernetes;
  • Auditoria e logging (CloudTrail, GuardDuty);
  • Arquitetura Zero Trust;
  • Certificações: AWS Security Specialty.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com sistemas financeiros e pagamentos instantâneos (PIX);
  • Integração HSM com requisitos de baixa latência;
  • Segurança para sistemas transacionais de alto throughput;
  • Conhecimento de conceitos de prevenção à fraude.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.
